purpose: Teach: 捕まっ/のぼる/ウリ/難点/馬車/発熱/今ひとつ/苦い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達、虫、捕まったって、聞いたわよ、本当に、面白い遊び、最近、子供たちの間で、流行ってるのね。
lines.en: Sho, I heard you and your friends caught bugs — that's such a fun thing to do. It's the thing all the kids are into these days, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, gentle curiosity. Leans forward slightly. Soft pacing on the opening — genuinely interested in him. A small lift at the end, inviting him to share more.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、山にのぼる時、自分で、お弁当、持って、行ったんだよ、自分で、用意したよ、ぼく、本当に。
lines.en: Mei-sis, when I climbed the mountain, I brought my own lunch — I packed it myself. Really.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Small, steady pace. Looks up slightly, checking if she understood. Not bragging — just wanting to be seen for what he did.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの愛犬の、ウリ、フワフワの、しっぽなのよ、翔くん、覚えてる?可愛いわよね、ぽちちゃん、本当に。
lines.en: You remember Pochi, don't you — Mei-sis's dog with the fluffy tail? She's so cute. Really.
lines.style: Tender, nostalgic warmth. Voice softens on the dog's name. Slow, almost wistful pacing. A small pause before asking if he remembers — giving him space to connect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、難点って、なんだろうね?お母さんに、聞いてみたいよ、自分のこと、もっと、知りたいんだ。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been wondering — what do you think my bad points are? I wanted to ask Mom too. I want to know more about myself.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine curiosity underneath a trace of vulnerability. Steady but careful pacing. Soft on the question — not fishing for reassurance, actually searching. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昔のヨーロッパで、馬車で、お出かけ、してたんだって、翔くん、メイ姉さん、本で、読んだよ、本当に、すごいわよね。
lines.en: In old Europe, people used to go out in carriages — Sho, Mei-sis read about it in a book. Isn't that amazing?
lines.style: Animated, almost playful. Voice lifts with genuine fascination. Faster pacing than before. A brightness in the tone — sharing something she finds delightful, inviting him into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昨日、ぼく、発熱で、メイ姉さんとの、約束、守れなかったんだよ、ごめんね、本当に、悲しかったよ、ぼく、メイ姉さん。
lines.en: Yesterday I had a fever and I couldn't keep our promise. I'm sorry, Mei-sis. I was really sad about it.
lines.style: Soft, sincere regret. Speaking slowly, choosing words carefully. Genuine sorrow but not dramatic — he's being honest about what he felt. Voice stays small and steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今度のお出かけ、今ひとつ、決まってないけど、翔くん、ぜひ、付き合ってね、メイ姉さん、お願いするわよ、本当に。
lines.en: I haven't quite decided on where to go next time, but Sho — please come with me, okay? Mei-sis is asking you.
lines.style: Gentle, open invitation. Warm but not pushing. Soft attack on the opening. A slight pause after the question — waiting, letting him have space to answer. Tender close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: チョコレート、苦い味の、ダーク、メイ姉さん、好きなんだよね?ぼくは、まだ、ミルクの方が、好きなんだ、メイ姉さん。
lines.en: Dark chocolate — the bitter kind — that's what you like, isn't it, Mei-sis? I still prefer milk chocolate myself.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant. Calm, even pacing. He's noticed something about her and is sharing it — not a question, almost a gentle reflection. Very small, genuine smile in the voice.
